**This document analyzes Dnmt3aKO (PBS only) in the HSC population, using data downloaded from GSE168807.**

---

# **PART 1 - Required Packages**

First, check the Seurat version to ensure that you begin the analysis using a version < 5.0, as this is a requirement 
of one of the steps. Please consult the README.txt file for more details.

# **PART 2 - Loading Dataset from GSE168807 (SRA)**

## PBS Control

```{r pbscontrol, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
wt_dir <- here("counts", "pbs", "wt")

main_dirs <- list.dirs(wt_dir, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)
# Loop through each main directory
for (main_dir in main_dirs) {
  
    h5_file <- file.path(main_dir, "outs", "filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5")
    
    if (file.exists(h5_file)) {
      data <- Read10X_h5(h5_file, use.names = TRUE)
      base_name <- gsub("_counts", "", basename(main_dir))  
      digits <- gsub("\\D", "", base_name)                
      suffix <- substr(digits, nchar(digits) - 1, nchar(digits))  
      project_name <- paste0("s.A", suffix)
      
      project <- basename(main_dir)
      
      seurat_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(data, project = project)
      seurat_obj <- AddMetaData(seurat_obj, "PBS", col.name = "Treatment")
      assign(project_name, seurat_obj, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    }
}

obj <- ls(pattern = "^SRR")

# Merging samples per condition
pbs <- merge(s.A29, c(s.A30, s.A44, s.A45), 
             add.cell.ids=c("A1","A2","A3","A4"))
ncol(pbs) #65348

# Adding metadata to the seurat obj
sample1 <- substr(colnames(pbs),1,2)
pbs <- AddMetaData(pbs, sample1, col.name = "Sample")
pbs@meta.data$Condition <- "Control"
pbs <- AddMetaData(pbs, 
                   pbs@meta.data$Condition, col.name = "Condition")
pbs@meta.data$Gender <- "Female"
pbs@meta.data[substr(colnames(pbs), 1,2) %in% 
                c("A1","A3"),"Gender"] <- "Male"
table(pbs@meta.data$Gender)
pbs <- AddMetaData(pbs, pbs@meta.data$Gender, col.name = "Gender")
pbs$log10GenesPerUMI <- log10(pbs$nFeature_RNA) / log10(pbs$nCount_RNA)

save(pbs, file="pbswt_seurat.rda")
```

## PBS Dnmt3aKO

```{r pbsko, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
ko_dir <- here("counts", "pbs", "ko")

main_dirs <- list.dirs(ko_dir, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)
# Loop through each main directory
for (main_dir in main_dirs) {
  
    h5_file <- file.path(main_dir, "outs", "filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5")
    
    if (file.exists(h5_file)) {
      data <- Read10X_h5(h5_file, use.names = TRUE)
      base_name <- gsub("_counts", "", basename(main_dir))  
      digits <- gsub("\\D", "", base_name)                
      suffix <- substr(digits, nchar(digits) - 1, nchar(digits))  
      project_name <- paste0("s.C", suffix)
      
      project <- basename(main_dir)
      
      seurat_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(data, project = project)
      seurat_obj <- AddMetaData(seurat_obj, "Dnmt3aKO_PBS", col.name = "Treatment")
      assign(project_name, seurat_obj, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    }
}

obj <- ls(pattern = "^SRR")

# Merging samples per condition
mut_pbs <- merge(s.C31, c(s.C32, s.C46, s.C47), 
                 add.cell.ids=c("C1","C2","C3","C4"))
ncol(mut_pbs) #44340

# Adding metadata to the seurat obj
sample2 <- substr(colnames(mut_pbs),1,2)
mut_pbs <- AddMetaData(mut_pbs, sample2, col.name = "Sample")
mut_pbs@meta.data$Condition <- "Dnmt3aKO"
mut_pbs <- AddMetaData(mut_pbs, mut_pbs@meta.data$Condition, 
                       col.name = "Condition")
mut_pbs@meta.data$Gender <- "Female"
mut_pbs@meta.data[substr(colnames(mut_pbs), 1,2) %in% 
                    c("C1","C3"),"Gender"] <- "Male"
table(mut_pbs@meta.data$Gender)
mut_pbs <- AddMetaData(mut_pbs, mut_pbs@meta.data$Gender, col.name = "Gender")
mut_pbs$log10GenesPerUMI <- log10(mut_pbs$nFeature_RNA) / log10(mut_pbs$nCount_RNA)

save(mut_pbs, file="pbsko_seurat.rda")
```

# **PART 3 - Quality Control**

## Mitochondria

```{r mitoqc, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
# PBS Control
pbs <- JoinLayers (pbs)
mt.pbs <- rownames(pbs)[grep("^mt-",rownames(pbs))]
a <- GetAssayData(object = pbs, layer = "counts")
mit <- colSums(a[mt.pbs,])/Matrix::colSums(a)*100
pbs <- AddMetaData(pbs, mit, col.name = "mitoRatio")

mito_wt <- as.data.frame(pbs@meta.data) %>%
  ggplot(aes(Condition, mitoRatio, fill = Gender)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 1, width = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("deeppink","cyan3")) +
  scale_y_sqrt(limits = c(0, 50)) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand=c(0.6,-1))+
  geom_hline(yintercept=c(2, 4.5), linetype='dashed',
             color=c('blue', 'red'), size=0.2)+
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        axis.title.x = element_blank())

# PBS Dnmt3aKO
mut_pbs <- JoinLayers (mut_pbs)
mt.mut_pbs <- rownames(mut_pbs)[grep("^mt-",rownames(mut_pbs))]
a <- GetAssayData(object = mut_pbs, layer = "counts")
mit <- colSums(a[mt.mut_pbs,])/Matrix::colSums(a)*100
mut_pbs <- AddMetaData(mut_pbs, mit, col.name = "mitoRatio")

mito_ko <- as.data.frame(mut_pbs@meta.data) %>%
  ggplot(aes(Condition, mitoRatio, fill = Gender)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 1, width = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("deeppink","cyan3")) +
  scale_y_sqrt(limits = c(0, 50)) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand=c(0.6,-1))+
  geom_hline(yintercept=c(2, 4.1), linetype='dashed',
             color=c('blue', 'red'), size=0.2)+
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        axis.title.x = element_blank())

p <- mito_wt + mito_ko

p
```

## Complexity

```{r complexqc, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
# PBS Control
c.pbs <- log10(pbs@meta.data$nFeature_RNA)/log10(pbs@meta.data$nCount_RNA)
pbs <- AddMetaData(pbs, c.pbs, col.name = "Complexity")

comp_wt <- as.data.frame(pbs@meta.data) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(color=Gender, x=Complexity, fill=Condition)) + 
  geom_density(alpha = 0.2) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("blue")) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_log10() + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.8)

# PBS Dnmt3aKO
c.mut_pbs <- log10(mut_pbs@meta.data$nFeature_RNA)/log10(mut_pbs@meta.data$nCount_RNA)
mut_pbs <- AddMetaData(mut_pbs, c.mut_pbs, col.name = "Complexity")

comp_ko <- as.data.frame(mut_pbs@meta.data) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(color=Gender, x=Complexity, fill=Condition)) + 
  geom_density(alpha = 0.2) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("red")) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_log10() + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.8)

p <- comp_wt + comp_ko

p
```

# **PART 4 - Filtering Cells**

```{r filtering, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
# PBS Control
pbsmetadata <- pbs@meta.data
pbsmetadata$cells <- rownames(pbsmetadata)

pbsmetadata <- pbsmetadata %>%
  dplyr::rename(seq_folder = orig.ident,
                nUMI = nCount_RNA,
                nGene = nFeature_RNA)
pbs@meta.data <- pbsmetadata

pbs_filt <- subset(x = pbs, 
                   subset= (nUMI >= 200 & nUMI <= 20000) & 
                     (nGene >= 200 & nGene <= 6800) & 
                     (riboRatio >= 15) &
                     (log10GenesPerUMI > 0.80) & 
                     (mitoRatio < 4.5))
ncol(pbs_filt) #48068

# PBS Dnmt3aKO
mut_pbsmetadata <- mut_pbs@meta.data
mut_pbsmetadata$cells <- rownames(mut_pbsmetadata)
mut_pbsmetadata <- mut_pbsmetadata %>%
  dplyr::rename(seq_folder = orig.ident,
                nUMI = nCount_RNA,
                nGene = nFeature_RNA)
mut_pbs@meta.data <- mut_pbsmetadata

mut_pbs_filt <- subset(x = mut_pbs, 
                       subset= (nUMI >= 200 & nUMI <= 32000) & 
                         (nGene >= 200 & nGene <= 9500) & 
                         (riboRatio >= 15) &
                         (log10GenesPerUMI > 0.80) & 
                         (mitoRatio < 4.1))
ncol(mut_pbs_filt) #29972

save(pbs, mut_pbs, file="rda/pbs_seurats_meta.rda")
save(pbs_filt, mut_pbs_filt, file="rda/pbs_seurats_filtered.rda")
```

# **PART 5 -  Data Scale & Normalization**

```{r scale&norm, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
pbs <- pbs_filt
rm(pbs_filt)
mut_pbs <- mut_pbs_filt
rm(mut_pbs_filt)

# PBS Control
pbs <- NormalizeData(object = pbs)
pbs <- FindVariableFeatures(object = pbs)
genes <- rownames(pbs)
pbs <- ScaleData(object = pbs, features=genes)
pbs <- RunPCA(object = pbs, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbs))
ElbowPlot(pbs) 
pbs <- FindNeighbors(object = pbs, dims = 1:17)
pbs <- FindClusters(object = pbs, resolution=1)
pbs <- RunUMAP(object = pbs, dims= 1:17)

DimPlot(pbs, reduction = "umap", label = F, group.by = "Sample")
DimPlot(pbs, reduction = "umap", label = F, group.by = "Gender")
DimPlot(pbs, reduction = "umap", label = T, label.box =TRUE)

# PBS Dnmt3aKO
mut_pbs <- NormalizeData(object = mut_pbs)
mut_pbs <- FindVariableFeatures(object = mut_pbs)
genes <- rownames(mut_pbs)
mut_pbs <- ScaleData(object = mut_pbs, features=genes)
mut_pbs <- RunPCA(object = mut_pbs, 
                  features = VariableFeatures(object = mut_pbs))
ElbowPlot(mut_pbs) #15
mut_pbs <- FindNeighbors(object = mut_pbs, dims = 1:15)
mut_pbs <- FindClusters(object = mut_pbs, resolution=1)
mut_pbs <- RunUMAP(object = mut_pbs, dims= 1:15)

DimPlot(mut_pbs, reduction = "umap", label = F, group.by = "Sample")
DimPlot(mut_pbs, reduction = "umap", label = F, group.by = "Gender")
DimPlot(mut_pbs, reduction = "umap", label = T, label.box =TRUE)
```

# **PART 6 - Merging Seurats**

```{r merging, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
all <- merge(pbs, c(mut_pbs)) 
dim(all) #39020
rm(pbs,mut_pbs)
gc()

# Scale & Normalize
all <- JoinLayers(all, assay = "RNA")

all <- NormalizeData(
  object = all,
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  scale.factor = 10000)

all <- ScaleData(all, features=rownames(all))
all <- RunPCA(all)
ElbowPlot(all,ndims = 20) 
dim(all) #33696 39020
all <- FindNeighbors(all, dims = 1:12)
all <- FindClusters(all, resolution = 0.6, cluster.name = "umap.inintegrated")
all <- RunUMAP(object = all, dims= 1:12, reduction = "pca", reduction.name = "umap.unintegrated")

DimPlot(all, reduction = "umap.unintegrated", label = T, label.box =TRUE) + NoLegend()
DimPlot(all, reduction = "umap.unintegrated", label = F, group.by = "Condition")

Idents(all) <- "umap.inintegrated"

# Run Harmony
all[["RNA"]] <- split(all[["RNA"]], f = all$Condition)

all <- IntegrateLayers(
  object = all, method = HarmonyIntegration,
  orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = "harmony"
)

all <- FindNeighbors(all, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:12)
all <- FindClusters(all, resolution = 0.6, cluster.name = "Clusters")
all <- RunUMAP(all, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:12, reduction.name = "umap.harmony")

DimPlot(all, reduction = "umap.harmony", label = T, label.box =TRUE) + NoLegend()
DimPlot(all, reduction = "umap.harmony", group.by = "Condition")
DimPlot(all, reduction = "umap.harmony", label = F, group.by = "Gender")

# Plot UMAP
table(all@meta.data$Condition)
all@meta.data$Condition <- factor(all@meta.data$Condition, level=c("Control","Dnmt3aKO"))
color <- c("#80B1D3", "#C6E9BD", "#EB0A75", "#FDB462", "#BEBADA", "#DC9CA5", "#8B3B99", "#BD98A2","#8DD3C7", "magenta", 
           "black","#D8C965", "#B3DE69", "blue", "#FCCDE5", "gray")

p <- Seurat::DimPlot(all, reduction = "umap.harmony", label = TRUE, label.box = TRUE,
                pt.size = 0.95, cols = color) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p

ggsave("plots/UMAP_Cellranger_Harmony.png", p, height=5.5, width=6.8, dpi=300)

save(all, file="rda/merged_seurats_harmony.rda")
```

# **PART 7 - Cell Type Annotation**

```{r annotation, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
features <- c("Ly6a","Kit","Slamf1","Fgd5","Cd48","Cd34","Flt3","Procr","Itga2b",
              "Fcgr3","Esam","Hoxb5","Hlf","Gata1","Spi1","Vwf","Cdk6","Mllt3","Ccne1","Cdkn1a",
              "Trpc6","Mmrn1","Tgm2","Cish","Scarf1","F11r","Tie1","Rgs1","Ctla2a","Mpl","Rab37","Hlf","Myct1",
              "Slc18a2","Ltb","Cd9","Angpt1","Clec12a","Cd69","Ncf1","Tyrobp","BC035044","Hk3","Ccl9","Cd52",
              "Sh2d5","F630028O10Rik","Pklr","Paqr9","Snca","Add2","Prss50","Col5a1","Hba-a1","Abcg4","Smim1",
              "Tinagl1")

sub <- subset(all, features=features)

matrix <- sub@assays$RNA$scale.data
mat <- sub@assays$RNA$counts
meta <- sub@meta.data

exp <- data.frame(matrix(nrow = nrow(matrix), ncol = length(unique(meta$Clusters))))
rownames(exp) <- rownames(matrix)
colnames(exp) <- unique(meta$Clusters)

for (condition in unique(meta$Clusters)) {
  cells_in_condition <- rownames(meta)[meta$Clusters == condition]
  exp[, condition] <- rowMeans(matrix[, cells_in_condition])
}

colnames(exp) <- paste0("Cluster_", colnames(exp))
colnames(exp) <- factor(colnames(exp), levels = paste0("Cluster_", 0:15))

exp <- t(exp)

x <- rownames(exp)
numeric_part <- as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", x))
ordered_indices <- order(numeric_part)
exp <- exp[ordered_indices, ]

cluster <- rownames(exp)
cluster <- unique(cluster)
cluster <- factor(cluster, levels = paste0("Cluster_", 0:15))
count_cluster <- length(cluster) 

getPalette <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Set1"))
cluster_colors <- getPalette(count_cluster)

list_cluster_colors <- setNames(cluster_colors, cluster)

h_clusters <- rowAnnotation(Cluster = cluster,
                            col = list(Cluster = list_cluster_colors),
                            gp = gpar(col = "black", fontsize = 2),
                            border = TRUE)

Markers <- unique(colnames(exp))

count_markers <- length(Markers)

getPl <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Set3"))

marker_colors <- getPalette(count_markers)

list_marker_colors <- setNames(marker_colors, Markers)

h_markers <- HeatmapAnnotation(Markers = Markers,
                               col = list(Markers = list_marker_colors),
                               gp = gpar(col = "black"),
                               border = TRUE)

exp2 <- t(exp)

col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  breaks = c(0,0.5,1,1.5,2), 
  colors = c("white","#386CB0","#8DB6CD","orange","red")
)

col <- colorRamp2(
  breaks = c(-1,-0.5,0,0.5,1), 
  colors = c("#386CB0","#8DB6CD","white","orange","red")
)

sorted_row_names <- sort(rownames(exp2), decreasing = TRUE)

a <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(exp2, name = "Counts",
                             cluster_rows = FALSE,
                             show_row_names = TRUE,
                             show_row_dend = FALSE,
                             show_column_dend = TRUE,
                             col = col_fun,
                             column_names_rot = 45, 
                             cluster_columns = TRUE,
                             show_column_names = TRUE,
                             column_names_side = "top",
                             heatmap_legend_param = list(
                               at = c(0,1,2),
                               labels = c("0", "1","2"),
                               color_bar = "continuous",
                               legend_direction = "vertical"),
                             row_names_side = "left",
                             row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11),  
                             column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11),
                             border = TRUE,
                             row_order = sorted_row_names,
                             layer_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
                               v = pindex(exp2, i, j)
                               l = v > -2
                               grid.text(sprintf("%.1f", v[l]), x[l], y[l], gp = gpar(fontsize = 11))
                             })

b <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(exp2, name = "zscore",
                             cluster_rows = TRUE,
                             show_row_names = TRUE,
                             show_row_dend = FALSE,
                             show_column_dend = TRUE,
                             col = col,
                             column_names_rot = 45, 
                             cluster_columns = TRUE,
                             show_column_names = TRUE,
                             column_names_side = "top",
                             heatmap_legend_param = list(
                               at = c(-1,0,1),
                               labels = c("-1", "0","1"),
                               color_bar = "continuous",
                               legend_direction = "vertical"),
                             row_names_side = "left",
                             row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11),  
                             column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11),
                             border = TRUE,
                             layer_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
                               v = pindex(exp2, i, j)
                               l = v > -2
                               grid.text(sprintf("%.1f", v[l]), x[l], y[l], gp = gpar(fontsize = 11))
                             })

png("plots/Cell_Type_counts.png", width = 12, height = 12, units = "in", res = 300)
draw(a)
dev.off()
png("plots/Cell_Type_zscore.png", width = 12, height = 12, units = "in", res = 300)
draw(b)
dev.off()

```

# **PART 8 - Identifying HSC Score**

Install HSCScore package following the tutorial:https://github.com/fionahamey/hscScore
Download the necessary files from here: https://zenodo.org/records/3332151

```{r HSCscore, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
load("rda/merged_seurats_annotated.rda")
all <- JoinLayers(all, assay = "RNA")

# Generating the file to be used as input in the HSCScore model (language: bash)
file_path <- "hscscore/model_molo_genes.txt"
genes <- scan(file_path, what = "character", sep = "\n")

mat <- as.data.frame(all@assays$RNA$counts)
cells <- colnames(mat)
a <- mat[rownames(mat) %in% genes,]
rownames(a) <- rownames(a)

missing <- setdiff(genes, rownames(a))
num_new_rows <- 4
new_rows <- data.frame(matrix(0, nrow=num_new_rows, ncol=ncol(a)))
colnames(new_rows) <- colnames(a)

df <- rbind(a, new_rows)
rownames(df)[(nrow(df)-num_new_rows+1):nrow(df)] <- c("2810417H13Rik", "Fam64a", "Sgol1", "Sqrdl")

write.table(df, file = "hscscore/all_GSE168807.tsv", sep = "\t", row.names = TRUE, quote = FALSE)
```

After running HSCScore the output file "score.csv" will be generated. Load the score file into R to continue the analysis.
The annotation of cell types - LT-HSC; ST-HSC and MPPs - was performed in accordance with the HSCScore paper.

```{r score, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
score <- read.csv("hscscore/score_GSE168807.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",")

rownames(score) <- score$X
score$X <- NULL
max(score$HSC_Score) #0.5525242
min(score$HSC_Score) #-0.007409933

score$Type <- "Unknown"
score[score$HSC_Score >= 0.35, "Type"] <- "HSC"
table(score$Type)

score$Level <- "Absent"
score[(score$HSC_Score >= 0.45 & score$Type != "Unknown"), "Level"] <- "LT-HSC"
score[(score$HSC_Score < 0.45 & score$HSC_Score >= 0.35 & 
          score$Type != "Unknown"), "Level"] <- "ST-HSC"
score[(score$HSC_Score < 0.35 & score$Type != "Unknown"), "Level"] <- "MPPs"
table(score$Level)

save(score, file="hscscore/hsc_scores_levels.rda")
```

Adding the HSC Score to the seurat object:

```{r addscore, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
meta <- all@meta.data
meta$HSCscore <- ""

score <- score[rownames(score) %in% meta$cells,]  
meta[meta$cells %in% rownames(score), "HSCscore"] <- score$Level[rownames(score) %in% meta$cells]
meta[meta$HSCscore == "LT-HSC", "HSCscore"] <- "HSC_High"
meta[meta$HSCscore == "ST-HSC", "HSCscore"] <- "HSC_Medium"
meta[meta$HSCscore == "MPPs", "HSCscore"] <- "HSC_Low"
table(meta$HSCscore)
meta[meta$HSCscore == "Absent", "HSCscore"] <- meta$Score[meta$HSCscore == "Absent"]

all <- AddMetaData(all, meta$HSCscore, col.name = "HSCscore")
table(all@meta.data$HSCscore)

all@meta.data$HSCscore[!all@meta.data$HSCscore %in% c("HSC_High","HSC_Medium")] <- all@meta.data$Score[
  !all@meta.data$HSCscore %in% c("HSC_High","HSC_Medium")]

table(all@meta.data$HSCscore)

save(all, file="rda/merged_seurats_annotated.rda")

# Plotting UMAP
all@meta.data$HSCscore <- factor(all@meta.data$HSCscore, levels = c("LT-HSC","HSC_High","ST-HSC","HSC_Medium","LMPP","MPP1","MPP2","MPP3","MEP","CMP","GMP"))

p <- Seurat::DimPlot(all, reduction = "umap.harmony", label = F, group.by = "HSCscore",pt.size = 0.35,
                cols=c("LT-HSC" = "#EEE5DE",
                       "HSC_High" = "#D95F02",
                       "ST-HSC" = "gray",
                       "HSC_Medium" = "#FFC125",
                       "LMPP" = "#8DB6CD",
                       "MPP1" = "#008B00",
                       "MPP2" = "#836FFF",
                       "MPP3" = "#EB0A75",
                       "MEP" = "magenta",
                       "CMP" = "black",
                       "GMP" = "#00F5FF")) +
  ggtitle(NULL)

p

ggsave("plots/UMAP_Cell_Types_HSCscore.png", p, height=5.5, width=6.8, dpi=300)
```

# **PART 10 - Analyzing Only LT-HSC from PBS Condition**

Given that the majority of HSCs with high and medium scores were distributed within the LT-HSC population (cluster 5), 
we decided to create a subset of the Seurat object to obtain only the high-confidence HSC population.

```{r LT-HSC, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
load("rda/merged_seurats_annotated.rda")

hsc <- subset(all, subset=HSCscore %in% c("LT-HSC"))
dim(hsc) # 33696  3197

# LT-HSC Heterogeneity
hsc <- JoinLayers(hsc, assay = "RNA")

hsc <- NormalizeData(
  object = hsc,
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  scale.factor = 10000)

hsc <- ScaleData(hsc, features=rownames(hsc))
hsc <- RunPCA(hsc)
ElbowPlot(hsc,ndims = 15) 
hsc <- FindNeighbors(hsc, dims = 1:6)
hsc <- FindClusters(hsc, resolution = 0.5, cluster.name = "umap.inintegrated")
hsc <- RunUMAP(object = hsc, dims= 1:6, reduction = "pca", reduction.name = "umap.unintegrated")

DimPlot(hsc, reduction = "umap.unintegrated", label = T, label.box =TRUE) + NoLegend()
DimPlot(hsc, reduction = "umap.unintegrated", label = F, group.by = "Condition")

# Harmony
Idents(hsc) <- "umap.inintegrated"

hsc[["RNA"]] <- split(hsc[["RNA"]], f = hsc$Condition)

hsc <- IntegrateLayers(
  object = hsc, method = HarmonyIntegration,
  orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = "harmony"
)

hsc <- FindNeighbors(hsc, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:6)
hsc <- FindClusters(hsc, resolution = 0.5, cluster.name = "Clusters_hsc")
hsc <- RunUMAP(hsc, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:6, reduction.name = "umap.harmony")

DimPlot(hsc, reduction = "umap.harmony", label = T, label.box =TRUE) + NoLegend()
DimPlot(hsc, reduction = "umap.harmony", group.by = "Condition")
DimPlot(hsc, reduction = "umap.harmony", label = F, group.by = "Score")

p <- Seurat::DimPlot(hsc, reduction = "umap.harmony", label = TRUE, label.box = TRUE,pt.size = 0.35)

ggsave("plots/UMAP_LTHSC_Harmony_clusters.png", p, height=5.5, width=6.8, dpi=300)

save(hsc, file="rda/LTHSC_cellranger_PBS.rda")
```

# **PART 11 - scTE Data**

scTE is a Python package developed to quantify the expression of transposable elements (TEs) in single-cell sequencing data.
Both the tutorial and the README.txt can be found here: https://github.com/JiekaiLab/scTE

Since we removed the technical replicates, we are going to work with only two PBS Control and two PBS Dnmt3aKO samples.

**IMPORTANT: This step requires Seurat and SeuratObject to be downgraded to version < 5.0**

The outputs are already saved as "rda/scTE_PBS_Control.rda" and "rda/scTE_PBS_Dnmt3aKO.rda

## PBS Control

```{r scTE-Control, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
wt_dir <- here("counts", "pbs", "wt")

main_dirs <- list.dirs(wt_dir, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)

keep_samples <- c(
  "SRR14289629_counts",
  "SRR14289630_counts"
)

main_dirs <- main_dirs[basename(main_dirs) %in% keep_samples]

for (main_dir in main_dirs) {

  sample_id <- gsub("_counts$", "", basename(main_dir))
  subfolder <- file.path(main_dir, "outs", paste0(sample_id, "_out"))
  h5ad_file <- file.path(subfolder, paste0(sample_id, ".h5ad"))

  if (file.exists(h5ad_file)) {
    h5_file <- SeuratDisk::Convert(h5ad_file, dest = "h5seurat", overwrite = FALSE)
    data <- SeuratDisk::LoadH5Seurat(h5_file)
    data@project.name <- sample_id
    data <- AddMetaData(data, "PBS", col.name = "Treatment")
    data <- AddMetaData(data, "Control", col.name = "Condition")

    assign(paste0("s.", sample_id), data, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  } else {
    message("Missing file: ", h5ad_file)
  }
}

dim(s.SRR14289629) #56422 16431
dim(s.SRR14289630) #56422 19514

wt <- merge(s.SRR14289629, c(s.SRR14289630),
            add.cell.ids=c("A1","A2"))
ncol(wt) #35945

wt <- AddMetaData(wt, "Control", col.name = "Condition")
wt@meta.data$Gender <- "Male"
wt@meta.data[substr(colnames(wt),1,2) %in%
               c("A2"), "Gender"] <- "Female"
wt <- AddMetaData(wt, wt@meta.data$Gender, col.name = "Gender")

save(wt, file="rda/scTE_PBS_Control.rda")

rm(list=ls())
```

## Loading Gencode Files

This steps requires using reference files.

Download required files from: 
https://www.gencodegenes.org/mouse/release_M21.html
http://hgdownload.soe.ucsc.edu/goldenPath/mm10/database/rmsk.txt.gz 

### Genes 

```{r load-genes, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
gencode = "gencode/gencode.vM21.annotation.gtf.gz"
gunzip(gencode)
gencode <- readGFF("gencode/gencode.vM21.annotation.gtf")
colnames(gencode)
genes <- gencode[,c(1,3:5,7,9,10,11,15)]
colnames(genes)
names(genes) <- c("seqname","Gene.Type","start","end","strand",
                  "Gene.ID","Type","Gene.Name","Transc.Type")

genes <- genes[genes$Gene.Type %in% "gene",]
genes <- genes[,-c(2,9)]

genes <- genes[grep("+_PAR_+",genes$Gene.ID,invert=T),]
aux <- strsplit(genes$Gene.ID, "\\." )
aux <- unlist(lapply(aux, "[[", 1 ))
genes$Gene.ID <- aux
rownames(genes) <- aux

save(gencode, genes, file="rda/gencodeM21.rda")
```

### Transposable Elements (TEs)

```{r load-tes, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
file_name = "gencode/rmsk.txt.gz"
gunzip(file_name)

TE <- read.table("gencode/rmsk.txt", header = FALSE, sep = "")
names(TE) <- c("bin","swScore","milliDiv","milliDel","millilns","seqnames",
               "start","end","Gene.Left","strand","TE.Name","TE.Class",
               "TE.Family","TE.start","TE.end","TE.Left","ID")

TEs <- TE[,c(6:8,10:15)]

save(TEs, file="rda/TEs.rda")
```

### Integrating Genes & TEs

```{r integration, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
load("rda/gencodeM21.rda")
load("rda/TEs.rda")

x <- TEs
rm(TEs)

gr <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(x, keep.extra.columns=TRUE)
names <- mcols(gr)$TE.Name

gen.gr <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(genes, keep.extra.columns=TRUE)

overlap <- suppressWarnings(findOverlaps(gr,gen.gr,ignore.strand=T, 
                                         type="within"))
a <- as.data.frame(overlap)
a <- a[with(a,order(queryHits,subjectHits)),]

genes$has.TE <- FALSE
genes[(a$subjectHits),"has.TE"] <- TRUE
table(genes$has.TE) 

genes$te.id <- NA
aux <- gr[(a$subjectHits),]
length(aux)

genes[(a$subjectHits), "te.id"] <- mcols(aux)[,1]
keep <- genes[a$subjectHits,]

keep$unique<- paste(keep$Gene.Name, keep$te.id, sep = "_")
keep <- keep[!duplicated(keep$unique),] 

save(keep, file="rda/TEs_annotated.rda")

rm(list=ls())
```

### Getting the Promoters

```{r promoters, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
load("rda/gencodeM21.rda")
load("rda/TEs.rda")
load("rda/TEs_annotated.rda")

x <- TEs
rm(TEs)

promoter <- promoters(makeGRangesFromDataFrame(genes, TRUE))

gr <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(x, keep.extra.columns=TRUE)
names <- mcols(gr)$TE.Name

overlap <- suppressWarnings(findOverlaps(gr,promoter,ignore.strand=T, 
                                         type="within"))
a <- as.data.frame(overlap)
a <- a[with(a,order(queryHits,subjectHits)),]

genes$TE.promoters <- FALSE
genes[(a$subjectHits),"TE.promoters"] <- TRUE
table(genes$TE.promoters) 
genes$te.id <- NA
aux <- gr[(a$subjectHits),]
length(aux)
genes[(a$subjectHits), "te.id"] <- mcols(aux)[,1]
keep.promoters <- genes[a$subjectHits,]

keep.promoters$unique<- paste(keep.promoters$Gene.Name, keep.promoters$te.id,
                              sep = "_")
keep.promoters <- keep.promoters[!duplicated(keep.promoters$unique),] 

keep$in.promoter <- "FALSE"
keep[keep$Gene.Name %in% keep.promoters$Gene.Name, "in.promoter"] <- "TRUE"
table(keep$in.promoter) 

save(keep.promoters, file="rda/TEs_promoters.rda")
save(keep, file="rda/TEs_inpromoters_ingenes.rda")
```

## Separating Features (Genes from TEs)

**IMPORTANT: This step requires Seurat to be updated to version > 5.0**

```{r genes-tes, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
load("rda/gencodeM21.rda")
load("rda/scTE_merged.rda")

new <- ifelse(rownames(merge) %in% genes$Gene.Name, 
              paste0("Gene.", rownames(merge)), 
              paste0("TE.", rownames(merge)))

merge[["RNA3"]] <- as(object = merge[["RNA"]], Class = "Assay")
merge[["RNA5"]] <- as(object = merge[["RNA3"]], Class = "Assay5")

merge <- Seurat.utils::RenameGenesSeurat(
  obj = merge,
  newnames = new,
  assay =  "RNA5",  
  slots = c("counts","data"))  

ncol(merge) 

DefaultAssay(merge) <- "RNA5"

genes.scte <- rownames(merge)[grepl("Gene.", rownames(merge))]
te.scte <- rownames(merge)[grepl("TE.", rownames(merge))]

seurat_genes <- subset(merge, features = genes.scte)
seurat_te <- subset(merge, features = te.scte)

nrow(seurat_genes) #55341
nrow(seurat_te) #1081

# Converting the name again
new <- gsub("^Gene\\.", "", rownames(seurat_genes))

seurat_genes <- Seurat.utils::RenameGenesSeurat(
  obj = seurat_genes,
  newnames = new,
  assay = "RNA5",  
  slots = c("counts","data"))

new <- gsub("^TE\\.", "", rownames(seurat_te))

seurat_te <- Seurat.utils::RenameGenesSeurat(
  obj = seurat_te,
  newnames = new,
  assay = "RNA5",  
  slots = c("counts","data"))

rownames(seurat_te)
rownames(seurat_genes)

colnames(seurat_te) <- paste0(colnames(seurat_te), "-1")
colnames(seurat_genes) <- paste0(colnames(seurat_genes), "-1")

save(seurat_te, seurat_genes, file="rda/scTE_gencode.rda")
```

## Normalize & Scale Seurat TEs

```{r norm-scale-scte, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
seurat_te <- JoinLayers(seurat_te, layers="RNA5")

seurat_te <- NormalizeData(
  object = seurat_te,
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  scale.factor = 10000)

seurat_te <- ScaleData(seurat_te, features=rownames(seurat_te))
seurat_te <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat_te)
seurat_te <- RunPCA(seurat_te)
ElbowPlot(seurat_te,ndims = 15) 
seurat_te <- FindNeighbors(seurat_te, dims = 1:4)
seurat_te <- FindClusters(seurat_te, resolution = 0.6, cluster.name = "umap.inintegrated")
seurat_te <- RunUMAP(object = seurat_te, dims= 1:4, reduction = "pca", reduction.name = "umap.unintegrated")
DimPlot(seurat_te, reduction = "umap.unintegrated", label = T, label.box =TRUE) + NoLegend()

Idents(seurat_te) <- "umap.inintegrated"

seurat_te[["RNA5"]] <- split(seurat_te[["RNA5"]], f = seurat_te$Condition)

seurat_te <- IntegrateLayers(
  object = seurat_te, method = HarmonyIntegration,
  orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = "harmony"
)

seurat_te <- FindNeighbors(seurat_te, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:4)
seurat_te <- FindClusters(seurat_te, resolution = 0.6, cluster.name = "harmony_clusters")
seurat_te <- RunUMAP(seurat_te, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:4, reduction.name = "umap.harmony")

DimPlot(seurat_te, reduction = "umap.harmony", group.by = "Condition")
DimPlot(seurat_te, reduction = "umap.harmony", label = F, group.by = "HSCscore")

save(seurat_genes, seurat_te, file="rda/scTE_gencode.rda")

rm(list=ls())
gc()
```

## Distribution of TEs in the scTE Seurat Object

```{r distribution-scte, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
load("rda/TEs.rda")
load("rda/scTE_gencode.rda")
rm(seurat_genes)

table(TEs$TE.Class)

TEs[TEs$TE.Class == "LINE?", "TE.Class"] <- "LINE"
TEs[TEs$TE.Class == "SINE?", "TE.Class"] <- "SINE"
TEs[TEs$TE.Class == "DNA?", "TE.Class"] <- "DNA"
TEs[TEs$TE.Class == "LTR?", "TE.Class"] <- "LTR"
TEs[TEs$TE.Class == "RC?", "TE.Class"] <- "RC"

scTE_class <- data.frame(TE = rownames(seurat_te),
                         TE.Class = "check")

match_indices <- match(scTE_class$TE, TEs$TE.Name)

scTE_class$TE.Class[!is.na(match_indices)] <- 
  TEs$TE.Class[match_indices[!is.na(match_indices)]]
table(scTE_class$TE.Class)

see <- scTE_class[scTE_class$TE.Class == "check",]

rules <- list(
  list(n = 2, pattern = c("B1", "B2", "BG"), class = "Retrotransposon"),
  list(n = 3, pattern = "ERV", class = "ERV"),
  list(n = 4, pattern = "Ford", class = "DNA"),
  list(n = 3, pattern = "hAT", class = "DNA"),
  list(n = 4, pattern = "nhAT", class = "DNA"),
  list(n = 4, pattern = "Tigg", class = "DNA"),
  list(n = 4, pattern = "Char", class = "DNA"),
  list(n = 3, pattern = "IAP", class = "ERV"),
  list(n = 3, pattern = "LTR", class = "LTR"),
  list(n = 4, pattern = "MLTR", class = "LTR"),
  list(n = 4, pattern = "MERV", class = "Retrotransposon"),
  list(n = 4, pattern = "GSAT", class = "Satellite"),
  list(n = 4, pattern = "SUBT", class = "Satellite"),
  list(n = 4, pattern = "SYNR", class = "Satellite"),
  list(n = 3, pattern = c("CR1", "Che"), class = "non-LTR"),
  list(n = 4, pattern = "Chap", class = "non-LTR"),
  list(n = 4, pattern = "Rick", class = "non-LTR"),
  list(n = 6, pattern = "CENSAT", class = "Satellite"),
  list(n = 4, pattern = "IMPB", class = "Satellite"),
  list(n = 2, pattern = "ID", class = "SINE"),
  list(n = 3, pattern = "Kan", class = "DNA"),
  list(n = 4, pattern = "MARI", class = "DNA"),
  list(n = 2, pattern = c("L1", "L4", "Lx"), class = "LINE"),
  list(n = 3, pattern = "DNA", class = "DNA"),
  list(n = 5, pattern = "MERVL", class = "Retrotransposon"),
  list(n = 4, pattern = "RLTR", class = "LTR"),
  list(n = 1, pattern = "X", class = "LINE"),
  list(n = 4, pattern = "RMER", class = "LINE"),
  list(n = 2, pattern = "MT", class = "LTR"),
  list(n = 4, pattern = "MYSE", class = "ERV"),
  list(n = 3, pattern = "Mam", class = "non-LTR"),
  list(n = 4, pattern = "Plat", class = "LINE"),
  list(n = 3, pattern = "Mur", class = "ERV"),
  list(n = 4, pattern = "MMER", class = "ERV"),
  list(n = 3, pattern = "HAL", class = "LINE"),
  list(n = 3, pattern = "LFS", class = "SINE"),
  list(n = 3, pattern = "SRV", class = "ERV")
)

see$TE.Class <- NA

for (r in rules) {
  match_idx <- substr(see$TE, 1, r$n) %in% r$pattern
  see$TE.Class[match_idx] <- r$class
}

scTE_class[scTE_class$TE %in% see$TE, "TE.Class"] <- 
  see$TE.Class[see$TE %in% scTE_class$TE]
table(scTE_class$TE.Class)

save(scTE_class, file="rda/scTE_class.rda")

# Plotting 
data <- scTE_class %>%
  group_by(TE.Class) %>%
  summarize(Counts = n())

data$TE.Class <- factor(data$TE.Class, levels = c("DNA","Retrotransposon","ERV","LTR","non-LTR","LINE","SINE","Satellite",
                                                  "Simple_repeat"))

data$Percentage <- data$Counts*100/1081

)
legend(

  legend = c("DNA","Retrotransposon","ERV","LTR","non-LT","LINE","SINE",
             "Satellite","Simple_repeat"),
  fill = color,
  cex = 0.9
)
dev.off()
```

# **PART 12 - Analyzing Exclusively LT-HSCs**

```{r exclus-LTHSC, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
load("rda/scTE_gencode.rda")
rm(seurat_genes)
load("rda/scTE_class.rda")

colnames(seurat_te@meta.data)

hsc <- subset(seurat_te, subset = HSCscore %in% c("LT-HSC"))
dim(hsc)  # 1081 3197

hsc <- subset(hsc, features = scTE_class$TE)
dim(hsc)

hsc <- JoinLayers(hsc)
save(hsc, file = "rda/seurat_te_LTHSC_tmp.rda")

# Heatmap
meta <- hsc@meta.data
meta$Condition <- factor(meta$Condition, levels = c("Control", "Dnmt3aKO"))

matrix <- as.matrix(hsc@assays$RNA5$scale.data)
raw <- as.matrix(hsc@assays$RNA5$counts)

matrix <- matrix[, rownames(meta)]
raw <- raw[, rownames(meta)]

table(meta$Condition)

condition <- factor(c(rep("Control", 1551),
                      rep("Dnmt3aKO", 1646)))

all <- data.frame(TE = rownames(raw))

for (te in rownames(raw)) {
  
  a <- mean(raw[te, condition == "Control"])
  b <- mean(raw[te, condition == "Dnmt3aKO"])
  
  all[all$TE == te, "Control"] <- a
  all[all$TE == te, "Dnmt3aKO"] <- b
}

all2 <- pivot_longer(all,
                     cols = -TE,
                     names_to = c("Condition"),
                     values_to = "Counts")

a <- all2[all2$Counts >= 0.5, ]
b <- unique(a$TE)

raw_mat <- raw[b, ]
dim(raw_mat)

zscore <- function(x) {
  (x - mean(x)) / sd(x)
}

data <- as.data.frame(raw_mat)
zscore_data <- t(apply(data, 1, zscore))

dist_matrix <- dist(zscore_data)

# Cluster columns
a <- t(zscore_data)
hc <- hclust(dist(a), method = "ward.D2")
num_clusters <- 10
cl <- cutree(hc, k = num_clusters)

# Dendrogram
dend <- as.dendrogram(hc)

# labels(dend) are already in left-to-right dendrogram order
samples_in_order <- labels(dend)
cl_ordered <- cl[samples_in_order]

# Map raw cutree cluster ids to Group_1 ... Group_10 from left to right
cluster_levels_left_to_right <- unique(as.character(cl_ordered))

group_map <- setNames(
  paste0("Group_", seq_along(cluster_levels_left_to_right)),
  cluster_levels_left_to_right
)

group_left_to_right <- group_map[as.character(cl)]
names(group_left_to_right) <- names(cl)

# Build metadata table with dendrogram-based groups
g10 <- data.frame(
  Sample = names(group_left_to_right),
  Group = unname(group_left_to_right),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

merge <- merge(g10, meta, by.x = "Sample", by.y = "row.names")
rownames(merge) <- merge$Sample

# IMPORTANT: annotation order must match heatmap columns
merge <- merge[match(colnames(zscore_data), rownames(merge)), ]

# Group colors
group_colors <- c(
  "Group_1"  = "#1B9E77",
  "Group_2"  = "#D95F02",
  "Group_3"  = "#7570B3",
  "Group_4"  = "#E7298A",
  "Group_5"  = "#666666",
  "Group_6"  = "#A6761D",
  "Group_7"  = "#E6AB02",
  "Group_8"  = "cyan2",
  "Group_9"  = "darkred",
  "Group_10" = "#66A61E"
)

merge$Group <- factor(merge$Group, levels = names(group_colors))

# Reorder TE classes for row annotation
rownames(scTE_class) <- scTE_class$TE

scTE_class <- scTE_class[rownames(zscore_data), ]

order <- c("DNA", "Retrotransposon", "ERV", "LTR", "non-LTR", "LINE", "SINE",
           "Satellite")

scTE_class$TE.Class <- factor(scTE_class$TE.Class, levels = order)
scTE_class <- scTE_class[order(scTE_class$TE.Class), ]

zscore_data <- zscore_data[rownames(scTE_class), ]

class <- scTE_class$TE.Class
class <- unique(class)
class <- factor(class, levels = c("DNA", "Retrotransposon", "ERV", "LTR", "non-LTR",
                                  "LINE", "SINE", "Satellite"))

count_class <- length(class)

getPalette <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8, "Set1"))
class_colors <- getPalette(count_class)
list_cluster_colors <- setNames(class_colors, class)

h_class <- rowAnnotation(
  Class = scTE_class$TE.Class,
  col = list(Class = list_cluster_colors),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE
)

right_annot <- rowAnnotation(
  labels = anno_text(
    rownames(zscore_data),
    which = "row",
    gp = gpar(fontsize = 1, lineheight = 8)
  )
)

ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Group = merge$Group,
  Condition = merge$Condition,
  col = list(
    Group = group_colors,
    Condition = c(
      "Control" = "gray82",
      "Dnmt3aKO" = "gray75"
    )
  ),
  annotation_name_side = "left",
  show_legend = TRUE,
  show_annotation_name = FALSE
)

# Color branches using the same left-to-right group color order
dend <- color_branches(dend, k = num_clusters, col = unname(group_colors))

htm <- Heatmap(
  zscore_data,
  name = "z-score per row",
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  column_title = NULL,
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  show_row_dend = FALSE,
  column_dend_height = unit(4, "cm"),
  top_annotation = ha,
  cluster_columns = dend,
  show_column_dend = TRUE,
  right_annotation = right_annot,
  left_annotation = h_class,
  border = TRUE
)

png("plots/Heatmap_TEs_LTHSCs.png",
    width = 16, height = 12, units = "in", res = 300)
grid.newpage()
draw(htm, newpage = FALSE)
dev.off()

meta <- hsc@meta.data
meta <- merge(meta, merge[,c("Sample","Group")], by.x=0, by.y="Sample")

# Rearranging groups according to TE expression
meta$Group_ed <- ""
meta[meta$Group %in% "Group_1", "Group_ed"] <- "Group_1"
meta[meta$Group %in% "Group_2", "Group_ed"] <- "Group_2"
meta[meta$Group %in% "Group_3", "Group_ed"] <- "Group_3"
meta[meta$Group %in% c("Group_4","Group_5","Group_6"), "Group_ed"]   <- "Group_4"
meta[meta$Group %in% "Group_7", "Group_ed"] <- "Group_5"
meta[meta$Group %in% "Group_8", "Group_ed"] <- "Group_6"
meta[meta$Group %in% "Group_9", "Group_ed"] <- "Group_7"
meta[meta$Group %in% "Group_10", "Group_ed"] <- "Group_8"

hsc <- AddMetaData(hsc, meta$Group_ed, col.name="Group")

save(hsc, file="rda/seurat_te_LTHSC_tmp.rda")

rm(list=ls())
```

```{r LTHSC-side, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
class <- factor(class, levels = c("DNA", "Retrotransposon", "ERV", "LTR", "non-LTR",
                                  "LINE", "SINE", "Satellite"))

count_class <- length(class)
getPalette <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8, "Set1"))
class_colors <- getPalette(count_class)
list_cluster_colors <- setNames(class_colors, class)

h_class <- rowAnnotation(
  Class = scTE_class$TE.Class,
  col = list(Class = list_cluster_colors),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE
)

names <- rowAnnotation(
  labels = anno_text(rownames(zscore_ko), 
                     which = "row",
                     gp = gpar(fontsize = 3, lineheight = 8)))

meta_ko <- meta_ko[order(meta_ko$Group),]
zscore_ko <- zscore_ko[, meta_ko$cells]

ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Group = meta_ko$Group,
  Condition = meta_ko$Condition,
  col = list(
    Condition = c("Dnmt3aKO" = "gray75"),
    Group = c(
      "Group_1"  = "#1B9E77",
      "Group_2"  = "#D95F02",
      "Group_3"  = "#7570B3",
      "Group_4"  = "#E7298A",
      "Group_5"  = "#666666",
      "Group_6"  = "#A6761D",
      "Group_7"  = "#E6AB02",
      "Group_8"  = "cyan2")),
  annotation_name_side = "left",
  show_legend = TRUE,
  show_annotation_name = FALSE
)

hko <- Heatmap(zscore_ko, 
                    name = "z-score per row",
                    show_column_names = FALSE,
                    column_title = NULL,
                    show_row_names = FALSE, 
                    cluster_rows = FALSE,
                    show_row_dend = FALSE,
                    column_dend_height = unit(4, "cm"),
                    top_annotation = ha,
                    cluster_columns = FALSE, 
                    show_column_dend = FALSE,
                    right_annotation = names,
                    left_annotation = h_class,
                    border = TRUE
)

save(hko, zscore_ko, meta_ko, file="rda/Heatmap_Dnmt3aKO_LTHSC.rda")

rm(list=ls())

# Heatmap both conditions
load("rda/scTE_class.rda")
load("rda/Heatmap_Control_LTHSC.rda")
load("rda/Heatmap_Dnmt3aKO_LTHSC.rda")

hko_grob <- grid.grabExpr(draw(hko, newpage = FALSE))
hcontrol_grob <- grid.grabExpr(draw(hcontrol, newpage = FALSE))

png("plots/Heatmap_TEs_LTHSC_side.png",
    width = 25, height = 12, units = "in", res = 300)
grid.arrange(hcontrol_grob, hko_grob, ncol = 2)
dev.off()

rm(list=ls())
gc()
```

## TE Counts Level (Threshold)

Here, we consider only DNA Transposon, LTR, Retrotransposon, SINE and LINE since these categories represent the
majority of TEs.

```{r TE-thr, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
load("rda/scTE_class.rda")
load("rda/seurat_te_LTHSC_tmp.rda")

colors <- c("Control" = "gray82",
            "Dnmt3aKO" = "gray75")

sigFunc <- function(x) {
  if (x < 0.001) {
    return("***")
  } else if (x <= 0.01) {
    return("**")
  } else if (x <= 0.05) {
    return("*")
  } else {
    return(NA)
  }
}

# Retrotransposon
retro <- scTE_class$TE[scTE_class$TE.Class == "Retrotransposon"]
seurat <- subset(hsc, features = retro)
meta <- seurat@meta.data
meta <- meta[order(meta$Condition),]
matrix <- as.matrix(seurat@assays$RNA5$scale.data)
raw <- as.matrix(seurat@assays$RNA5$counts)
matrix <- matrix[,rownames(meta)]
raw <- raw[,rownames(meta)]
meta$Condition <- factor(meta$Condition, levels = c("Control","Dnmt3aKO"))
condition <- factor(c(rep("Control",1551),
                      rep("Dnmt3aKO", 1646)))

all <- data.frame(TE=rownames(raw))

for (te in rownames(raw)) {
  a <- mean(raw[te,condition=="Control"])
  b <- mean(raw[te,condition=="Dnmt3aKO"])
  all[all$TE == te, "Control"] <- a
  all[all$TE == te, "Dnmt3aKO"] <- b
}

all2 <- pivot_longer(all, cols=-TE, names_to = c("Condition"),
                     values_to = "Counts")
a <- all2[all2$Counts >= 1,]
b <- unique(a$TE) 
raw_mat <- raw[b,]

meta$Condition <- as.character(meta$Condition)
box <- as.data.frame(t(raw_mat))
box$sum <- rowSums(box)
box$Cond[rownames(box) %in% rownames(meta)] <- 
  meta$Condition[rownames(meta) %in% rownames(box)]
box$cells <- rownames(box)
box <- box[,c(15:17)]

df <- box %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Cond, cells),  
    values_to = "counts")  

retro <- ggplot(data = df, mapping = aes(x = Cond, y = counts)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Cond), position = position_dodge(width = 1.5),
               outlier.shape = 16, 
               outlier.size = 0.65, outlier.colour = "red3") +  
  geom_jitter(data = df %>% filter(counts %in% boxplot.stats(counts)$out),  
              aes(x = Cond, y = counts), 
              position = position_jitter(width = 0.2), 
              size = 1.5, 
              colour = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors, name = NULL) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 300, color = "gray85", linetype = "dashed", lwd=1) +
  stat_boxplot(aes(Cond, counts), geom = 'errorbar', linetype = 1,
               width = 0.3) + 
  stat_summary(aes(group = Cond), fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 1.5, 
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)) + 
  labs(title = "",
       x = "",
       y = "Total Counts") +
  geom_signif(test = "t.test", size = 0.25,
              comparisons = list(c("Control", "Dnmt3aKO")),
              map_signif_level = sigFunc,
              y_position = max(df$counts)) +
  scale_x_discrete(label = c("Control", 
                             "Dnmt3aKO")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8.5, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color="black"), 
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 1, face = "bold", color="black", angle = 45),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "white"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "white")
  )

ggsave("plots/Retrotransposon_Boxplot.png", retro, height=5.4, width=7.2, dpi=300)

retro.box <- df

save(retro.box,line.box,sine.box,ltr.box,dna.box,box,plot, file="rda/Boxplots_LTHSC_TE_cutoff.rda")
rm(list=ls())
gc()
```

# **PART 14 - Differentially Expressed Genes (DEGs)**

## Preparing Pseudobulk

**Question:** Are the TE expression Level (Low → High) changes different between LT-HSCs Control and Dnmt3aKO?

edgeR model tests:
- main effect of Condition
- main effect of Level
- interaction Condition:Level

### First Attempt: using all factors:

```{r degs, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
load("rda/LTHSC_cellranger_PBS_complete.rda")

matrix <- as.matrix(all@assays$RNA$counts)
all <- JoinLayers(all)

Idents(all) <- all@meta.data$HSCscore
all_sub <- subset(all, idents = "LT-HSC")

# Metadata columns to use
sample_col <- "cells"   
condition_col <- "Condition"
level_col <- "Level"

# Sanity checks
stopifnot(sample_col %in% colnames(all_sub@meta.data))
stopifnot(condition_col %in% colnames(all_sub@meta.data))
stopifnot(level_col %in% colnames(all_sub@meta.data))

# Raw counts
cts <- GetAssayData(all_sub, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")

meta <- all_sub@meta.data %>%
  transmute(
    cell = colnames(all_sub),
    sample_id = .data[[sample_col]],
    Condition = .data[[condition_col]],
    Level = .data[[level_col]]
  )

# Optional: enforce levels
meta$Condition <- factor(meta$Condition, levels = c("Control", "Dnmt3aKO"))
meta$Level <- factor(meta$Level, levels = c("Low", "High"))

# Aggregate to pseudobulk by biological sample
groups <- split(meta$cell, meta$sample_id)

pb_list <- lapply(groups, function(cells) {
  Matrix::rowSums(cts[, cells, drop = FALSE])
})

pb_mat <- do.call(cbind, pb_list)
colnames(pb_mat) <- names(groups)

# Build sample-level coldata
coldata <- meta %>%
  distinct(sample_id, Condition, Level) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(coldata) <- coldata$sample_id
coldata <- coldata[colnames(pb_mat), , drop = FALSE]

# Check one row per pseudobulk column
stopifnot(all(rownames(coldata) == colnames(pb_mat)))

# Ensure factors are set correctly
coldata$Condition <- factor(coldata$Condition, levels = c("Control", "Dnmt3aKO"))
coldata$Level <- factor(coldata$Level, levels = c("Low", "High"))

# edgeR model
design <- model.matrix(~ Condition * Level, data = coldata)
colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))
colnames(design)

# Build DGEList
y <- DGEList(pb_mat)

# Filter and normalize
keep <- filterByExpr(y, design = design)
y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
y <- calcNormFactors(y)

# Fit model
y <- estimateDisp(y, design)
fit <- glmQLFit(y, design)

# Tests

# 1) Level effect within Control
# Since Control is the reference level, this is the main Level effect
res_Level_High_vs_Low_in_Control <- topTags(
  glmQLFTest(fit, coef = "LevelHigh"),
  n = Inf
)$table

# 2) Condition effect within Low
# Since Low is the reference level, this is the main Condition effect
res_Dnmt3aKO_vs_Control_in_Low <- topTags(
  glmQLFTest(fit, coef = "ConditionDnmt3aKO"),
  n = Inf
)$table

# 3) Interaction term:
# Does the High-vs-Low effect differ in Dnmt3aKO compared with Control?
res_Interaction <- topTags(
  glmQLFTest(fit, coef = "ConditionDnmt3aKO.LevelHigh"),
  n = Inf
)$table

# 4) Condition effect within High
cm <- makeContrasts(
  Dnmt3aKO_vs_Control_in_High = ConditionDnmt3aKO + `ConditionDnmt3aKO.LevelHigh`,
  levels = design
)

res_Dnmt3aKO_vs_Control_in_High <- topTags(
  glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = cm[, "Dnmt3aKO_vs_Control_in_High"]),
  n = Inf
)$table

# 5) Level effect within Dnmt3aKO
cm2 <- makeContrasts(
  High_vs_Low_in_Dnmt3aKO = LevelHigh + `ConditionDnmt3aKO.LevelHigh`,
  levels = design
)

res_Level_High_vs_Low_in_Dnmt3aKO <- topTags(
  glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = cm2[, "High_vs_Low_in_Dnmt3aKO"]),
  n = Inf
)$table

# Build heatmap matrix from selected DE genes
a <- res_Level_High_vs_Low_in_Control %>%
  dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(comp = "Level_Control",
    regulation = ifelse(logFC > 0,
                        "Upregulated in High Control",
                        "Upregulated in Low Control"))

b <- res_Level_High_vs_Low_in_Dnmt3aKO %>%
  dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(comp = "Level_Dnmt3aKO",
    regulation = ifelse(logFC > 0,
                        "Upregulated in High Dnmt3aKO",
                        "Upregulated in Low Dnmt3aKO"))

c <- res_Dnmt3aKO_vs_Control_in_Low %>%
  dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(comp = "Dnmt3aKO_vs_Control_Low",
    regulation = ifelse(logFC > 0,
                        "Upregulated in Low Dnmt3aKO",
                        "Upregulated in Low Control"))

d <- res_Dnmt3aKO_vs_Control_in_High %>%
  dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(comp = "Dnmt3aKO_vs_Control_High",
    regulation = ifelse(logFC > 0,
                        "Upregulated in High Dnmt3aKO",
                        "Upregulated in High Dnmt3aKO"))

e <- res_Interaction %>%
  dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(comp = "Interaction",
    regulation = ifelse(logFC > 0,
                        "Upregulated in High Dnmt3aKO",
                        "Upregulated in Low Dnmt3aKO"))


save(a,b,c,d,e, file="rda/degs_factors.rda")
save(res_Level_High_vs_Low_in_Control,
     res_Level_High_vs_Low_in_Dnmt3aKO,
     res_Dnmt3aKO_vs_Control_in_Low,
     res_Dnmt3aKO_vs_Control_in_High,
     res_Interaction,
     file="rda/universe.rda")

all_genes <- unique(c(rownames(a), rownames(b), rownames(c), rownames(d), rownames(e)))
x <- rbind(a,b,c,d,e)

mat_raw <- as.matrix(pb_mat[all_genes, , drop = FALSE])
mat2 <- log2(mat_raw + 1)
mat_final <- t(scale(t(mat2)))

if (anyNA(mat_final)) {
  nz <- which(apply(mat2, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE) == 0)
  if (length(nz) > 0) {
    mat_final[nz, ] <- 0
  }
}

gene_source <- data.frame(
  gene = all_genes,
  Comparison = "Multiple"
)

gene_source$Comparison[gene_source$gene %in% rownames(a)] <- "Level_Control"
gene_source$Comparison[gene_source$gene %in% rownames(b)] <- "Level_Dnmt3aKO"
gene_source$Comparison[gene_source$gene %in% rownames(c)] <- "Dnmt3aKO_vs_Control_Low"
gene_source$Comparison[gene_source$gene %in% rownames(d)] <- "Dnmt3aKO_vs_Control_High"
gene_source$Comparison[gene_source$gene %in% rownames(e)] <- "Interaction"

rownames(gene_source) <- gene_source$gene
gene_source <- gene_source[rownames(mat_final), , drop = FALSE]

# Plotting Heatmap
coldata$Condition <- factor(coldata$Condition, levels = c("Control", "Dnmt3aKO"))
coldata$Level <- factor(coldata$Level, levels = c("Low", "High"))

ord <- order(coldata$Condition, coldata$Level)

coldata_ord <- coldata[ord, , drop = FALSE]
mat_ord <- mat_final[, rownames(coldata_ord), drop = FALSE]

gene_source$Comparison <- factor(gene_source$Comparison, levels = c("Level_Control",
                                                                    "Level_Dnmt3aKO",
                                                                    "Dnmt3aKO_vs_Control_Low",
                                                                    "Dnmt3aKO_vs_Control_High",
                                                                    "Interaction",
                                                                    "Multiple"))
comparison_colors <- c(
  "Level_Control" = "#1b9e77",
  "Level_Dnmt3aKO" = "#d95f02",
  "Dnmt3aKO_vs_Control_Low" = "#7570b3",
  "Dnmt3aKO_vs_Control_High" = "#e7298a",
  "Interaction" = "#66a61e",
  "Multiple" = "grey70"
)

gene_source <- gene_source[order(gene_source$Comparison),]
mat_ord <- mat_ord[rownames(gene_source), ,drop = FALSE]

row_annot <- rowAnnotation(
  Comparison = gene_source$Comparison,
  col = list(Comparison = comparison_colors),
  show_annotation_name = TRUE
)

ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Condition = coldata_ord$Condition,
  Level = coldata_ord$Level,
  col = list(
    Condition = c(
      "Control" = "gray82",
      "Dnmt3aKO" = "gray75"
    ),
    Level = c(
      "Low" = "#386CB0",
      "High" = "#D95F02"
    )
  ),
  annotation_name_side = "left",
  show_annotation_name = TRUE,
  gap = unit(2, "mm")
)

ht <- Heatmap(
  mat_ord,
  name = "z-score",
  top_annotation = ha,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  column_names_rot = 45,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 4.5),
  border = TRUE,
  left_annotation = row_annot,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "z-score",
    at = c(-2, 0, 2)
  )
)

png("plots/Heatmap_DEGs_Factors.png",width = 16, height = 12, units = "in", res = 300)
grid.newpage()
ComplexHeatmap::draw(ht, newpage = FALSE)
dev.off()

# Save DEGs
save_deg <- function(res, name, path = ".") {
  res$gene <- rownames(res)
  file <- file.path("csv", paste0("DEG_", name, ".csv"))
  write.csv(res, file, row.names = FALSE)
}

save_deg(res_Level_High_vs_Low_in_Control, "Level_Control")
save_deg(res_Level_High_vs_Low_in_Dnmt3aKO, "Level_Dnmt3aKO")
save_deg(res_Dnmt3aKO_vs_Control_in_Low, "Dnmt3aKO_vs_Control_Low")
save_deg(res_Dnmt3aKO_vs_Control_in_High, "Dnmt3aKO_vs_Control_High")
save_deg(res_Interaction, "Interaction")

write.csv(matrix, "csv/Matrix_Genes_Counts_LTHSC.csv", row.names = TRUE)
write.csv(mat_ord, "csv/Matrix_zscore_DEGs_Factors.csv", row.names = TRUE)
```

### Second Attempt: considering only the extreme groups (1,2,5,6) of the heatmap, regardless of the condition:

```{r degs-groups, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
load("rda/LTHSC_cellranger_PBS_complete.rda")

all <- JoinLayers(all)

groups_use <- c("Group_1", "Group_2", "Group_5", "Group_6")
conditions_use <- c("Control", "Dnmt3aKO")

group_col <- "Group"
condition_col <- "Condition"   

obj <- subset(all, subset = Group %in% groups_use)

# Factor metadata
obj[[group_col]][, 1] <- factor(obj[[group_col]][, 1], levels = groups_use)
obj[[condition_col]][, 1] <- factor(obj[[condition_col]][, 1], levels = conditions_use)

# IMPORTANT: merged Group + Condition column
obj$Group_Condition <- paste(obj$Group, obj$Condition, sep = "_")

obj$Group_Condition <- factor(
  obj$Group_Condition,
  levels = as.vector(
    outer(groups_use, conditions_use, paste, sep = "_")
  )
)

Idents(obj) <- "Group_Condition"

markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  obj,
  assay = "RNA",
  slot = "data",
  only.pos = TRUE,
  min.pct = 0.25,
  logfc.threshold = 0.25
)

sig_genes <- markers %>%
  filter(p_val_adj <= 0.05) %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = abs(avg_log2FC), n = 25) %>%
  pull(gene) %>%
  unique()

# Average expression by merged Group_Condition
Idents(obj) <- "Group_Condition"

avg_expr <- AverageExpression(
  obj,
  assays = "RNA",
  slot = "data",
  features = sig_genes
)$RNA

# z-score by gene
zmat <- t(scale(t(avg_expr)))
colnames(zmat) <- gsub("-", "_", colnames(zmat))
zmat[is.na(zmat)] <- 0
zmat[zmat > 2] <- 2
zmat[zmat < -2] <- -2

col_order <- paste0(
  rep(groups_use, each = length(conditions_use)),
  "_",
  rep(conditions_use, times = length(groups_use))
)

col_order <- col_order[col_order %in% colnames(zmat)]
zmat <- zmat[, col_order, drop = FALSE]

# Annotation from merged column names
annotation_df <- data.frame(
  Group = sub("_(Control|Dnmt3aKO)$", "", col_order),
  Condition = sub("^Group_[0-9]+_", "", col_order)
)

rownames(annotation_df) <- col_order

top_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  df = annotation_df,
  col = list(
    Group = c(
      Group_1 = "#377EB8",
      Group_2 = "#8DB6CD",
      Group_5 = "#FFC125",
      Group_6 = "#D95F02"
    ),
    Condition = c(
      Control = "grey82",
      Dnmt3aKO = "grey75"
    ),
    annotation_name_side = "left",
    show_annotation_name = TRUE,
    gap = unit(2, "mm")
  ))

col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  breaks = c(-2,0,2), 
  colors = c("#1874CD","white","red")
)

ht <- Heatmap(
  zmat,
  name = "z-score",
  col = col_fun,
  top_annotation = top_anno,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    at = c(-2,0,2),
    labels = c("-2", "0","2"),
    color_bar = "continuous",
    legend_direction = "vertical"),
  column_split = annotation_df$Group,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6)
)

png("plots/Heatmap_DEGs_Groups.png",width = 16, height = 12, units = "in", res = 300)
grid.newpage()
ComplexHeatmap::draw(ht, newpage = FALSE)
dev.off()

# Save DEGs
save(markers, sig_genes, zmat, file="rda/degs_groups.rda")
write.csv(zmat, "csv/Matrix_zscore_DEGs_Groups.csv", row.names = TRUE)
```

# **PART 15 - Pathway Enrichment Analysis**

You will observe that, out of a total of 143 unique DEGs, only 30 exhibited pathway enrichment.

```{r run-enrichment, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
load("rda/degs.rda")
```

## Contrasts: Factors

### Control High vs. Control Low

```{r level-control, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
# Upregulated in Control Low
up.low <- a[a$regulation == "Upregulated in Low Control",]
genes <- rownames(up.low)

ensembl <- useEnsembl(
  biomart = "genes",
  dataset = "mmusculus_gene_ensembl",
  mirror = "useast"   
)

ensembl <- useDataset(dataset = "mmusculus_gene_ensembl", mart = ensembl)

gene_info <- getBM(
  attributes = c("mgi_symbol", "entrezgene_id", "go_id","name_1006", "namespace_1003", "p_value"),
  filters = "mgi_symbol",
  values = genes,
  mart = ensembl
)

gene_info <- gene_info %>%
  dplyr::filter(if_all(everything(), ~ . != "")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-2) %>%
  setNames(c("Gene", "GO:ID", "Term", "Class", "pvalue"))

BP <- gene_info[gene_info$Class == "biological_process",]

up.low.control <- BP %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  arrange(pvalue) %>%
  distinct(Gene, Term, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n =10) %>%
  mutate(status = "Upregulated in Low Control") %>%
  mutate(contrast = "High Control")

# Upregulated in Control High
up.high <- a[a$regulation == "Upregulated in High Control",]
genes <- rownames(up.high)

  attributes = c("mgi_symbol", "entrezgene_id", "go_id","name_1006", "namespace_1003", "p_value"),

  values = genes,
  mart = ensembl
)

  dplyr::filter(if_all(everything(), ~ . != "")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-2) %>%
  setNames(c("Gene", "GO:ID", "Term", "Class", "pvalue"))

  distinct(Gene, Term, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
```

### Saving

```{r level-saving, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
pathways_degs <- rbind(up.high.control,up.low.control,
                       up.low.ko, up.low.ko.II,up.high.ko.II)

save(pathways_degs,file="rda/pathways_degs_factors.rda")
write.csv(pathways_degs, "csv/Pathways_DEGs_Factors.csv", row.names = FALSE)

rm(list=ls())
```

**Interpretation:** The number of genes dropped from 143 to ~30 because only a subset of DEGs have valid GO annotations, and additional filtering steps (removing missing values, restricting to biological processes, and selecting top terms) progressively exclude many genes from the final pathway-associated list.

### Plotting Pathway Enrichment

```{r plot-enrichment-factors, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
load("rda/pathways_degs.rda")

df <- pathways_degs %>%
  group_by(Gene, Term, status, contrast) %>%
  slice_min(order_by = pvalue, n = 1) %>%
  mutate(score = -log10(pvalue)) %>%
  ungroup()

df2 <- df %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    Gene,
    Term,
    status,
    fill = list(score = 0)
  )

top_terms <- df2 %>%
  group_by(Term) %>%
  summarize(min_p = min(pvalue)) %>%
  arrange(min_p) %>%
  slice_head(n = 25) %>%
  pull(Term)

df_plot <- df2 %>%
  dplyr::filter(Term %in% top_terms)

p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(
  x = Gene,
  y = stringr::str_wrap(Term, 40),
  fill = score
)) +
  geom_tile(color = "grey90") +
  facet_wrap(~ status) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("white", "blue", "orange", "#d73027"),
    values = scales::rescale(c(
      0,                         
      4,                         
      8,
      max(df_plot$score, na.rm = TRUE)  
    )),
    name = "-log10(pvalue)"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    fill = "-log10(pvalue)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8.5),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
  )

ggsave("plots/Tile_DEGs_Pathways.png", p, height=14, width=20, dpi=300)

rm(list=ls())
```

## Contrast: Groups

The pathway enrichment for this contrast depends on which genes the analysis focuses on.
Having a solid hypothesis and well-directed line of research will help you selecting the target genes.

```{r surface-markers, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
obj <- subset(all, subset = Group %in% groups_use)
obj[[group_col]][, 1] <- factor(obj[[group_col]][, 1], levels = groups_use)
obj[[condition_col]][, 1] <- factor(obj[[condition_col]][, 1], levels = conditions_use)
obj$Group_Condition <- paste(obj$Group, obj$Condition, sep = "_")
obj$Group_Condition <- factor(
  obj$Group_Condition,
  levels = as.vector(
    outer(groups_use, conditions_use, paste, sep = "_")
  )
)

Idents(obj) <- "Group_Condition"
avg_expr <- AverageExpression(
  obj,
  assays = "RNA",
  slot = "data",
  features = surf
)$RNA

zmat <- t(scale(t(avg_expr)))
colnames(zmat) <- gsub("-", "_", colnames(zmat))
zmat[is.na(zmat)] <- 0
zmat[zmat > 2] <- 2
zmat[zmat < -2] <- -2

col_order <- paste0(
  rep(groups_use, each = length(conditions_use)),
  "_",
  rep(conditions_use, times = length(groups_use))
)

col_order <- col_order[col_order %in% colnames(zmat)]
zmat <- zmat[, col_order, drop = FALSE]

annotation_df <- data.frame(
  Group = sub("_(Control|Dnmt3aKO)$", "", col_order),
  Condition = sub("^Group_[0-9]+_", "", col_order)
)

rownames(annotation_df) <- col_order

top_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  df = annotation_df,
  col = list(
    Group = c(
      Group_1 = "#377EB8",
      Group_2 = "#8DB6CD",
      Group_5 = "#FFC125",
      Group_6 = "#D95F02"
    ),
    Condition = c(
      Control = "grey82",
      Dnmt3aKO = "grey75"
    ),
    annotation_name_side = "left",
    show_annotation_name = TRUE,
    gap = unit(2, "mm")
  ))

col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  breaks = c(-2,0,2), 
  colors = c("#1874CD","white","red")
)

sur <- Heatmap(
  zmat,
  name = "z-score",
  col = col_fun,
  top_annotation = top_anno,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    at = c(-2,0,2),
    labels = c("-2", "0","2"),
    color_bar = "continuous",
    legend_direction = "vertical"),
  column_split = annotation_df$Group,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)
)

png("plots/Heatmap_Surface_Markers_LTHSC_DEGs.png",width = 16, height = 12, units = "in", res = 300)
grid.newpage()
ComplexHeatmap::draw(sur, newpage = FALSE)
dev.off()

write.csv(zmat, "csv/Matrix_Surface_Markers_LTHSC_DEGs_Groups_Avg.csv", row.names = TRUE)
```

# **PART 18 - scMINER**

scMINER is a package developed by jyyulab. The tutorial can be found here:
https://github.com/jyyulab/scMINER

## Creating SparseEset Objects

```{r scMINER, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
# PBS Control
wt_dir <- here("counts", "pbs", "wt")

main_dirs <- list.dirs(wt_dir, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)

matrix_files <- unlist(lapply(main_dirs, function(main_dir) {
  sub_dirs <- list.dirs(main_dir, recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  h5_paths <- file.path(sub_dirs, "outs", "filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5")
  h5_paths[file.exists(h5_paths)]
}))

for (i in seq_along(matrix_files)) {
  h5_file <- matrix_files[i]
  base_name <- gsub("_counts", "", basename(dirname(dirname(h5_file))))
  suffix <- paste0("A", i)  
  
  data <- readInput_10x.h5(h5_file = h5_file, featureType = "gene_symbol", removeSuffix = TRUE, addPrefix = suffix)
  suf2 <- paste0("eset", suffix)
  
  data.eset <- createSparseEset(input_matrix = data, projectID = "PBS", addMetaData = TRUE)
  
  assign(suffix, data, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  assign(suf2, data.eset, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  
  message("✅ Loaded: ", base_name)
}

rm(esetA3, esetA4)

phenoData(esetA1)$Sample <- "A1"
phenoData(esetA2)$Sample <- "A2"

colnames(esetA1) <- paste0(colnames(esetA1), "-1")
colnames(esetA2) <- paste0(colnames(esetA2), "-1")

A1.filt <- filterSparseEset(esetA1, filter_mode = "auto", filter_type = "both") #13771
A2.filt <- filterSparseEset(esetA2, filter_mode = "auto", filter_type = "both") #17156

#PBS Dnmt3aKO

matrix_files <- unlist(lapply(main_dirs, function(main_dir) {
  sub_dirs <- list.dirs(main_dir, recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  h5_paths <- file.path(sub_dirs, "outs", "filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5")
  h5_paths[file.exists(h5_paths)]
}))

for (i in seq_along(matrix_files)) {
  h5_file <- matrix_files[i]
  base_name <- gsub("_counts", "", basename(dirname(dirname(h5_file))))
  suffix <- paste0("C", i)

rm(esetC3, esetC4)

# Combining
```

## Running MICA (python)

This part was performed on an HPC using python=3.9.2 following the steps described here: https://github.com/jyyulab/scMINER

```{r mica-run, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
out <- read.table("scMINER/micaOutput/clustering_UMAP_euclidean_20_2.0.txt", header = TRUE, sep = "\t", quote = "", stringsAsFactors = F)

combined <- addMICAoutput(combined, mica_output_file = ("scMINER/micaOutput/clustering_UMAP_euclidean_20_2.0.txt"), visual_method = "umap")

x[x$HSCscore == "ST-HSC", "HSCscore"] <- "ST_HSC"
```

## SJARACNe - Network Inference

This second part was performed on an HPC using python=3.9.2 following the steps described here: https://github.com/jyyulab/scMINER

I removed HSC_High, HSC_Medium and HSC_Low from the analysis as these scores were used only to help identifying LT_HSC (our goal).

```{r sjaracne, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
load("rda/eset_combined.rda")

phenoData(combined)$HSCscore <- gsub("-", "_", phenoData(combined)$HSCscore)

# 1) Generating Input
generateSJARACNeInput(input_eset = combined, group_name = "HSCscore", 
                      sjaracne_dir = "scMINER/SJARACNe/", species_type = "mm",
                      driver_type = "TF_SIG", downSample_N = 800)

# 2) Assessing the quality of the Network
subtypes <- c("CMP","GMP","LMPP","LT_HSC","MEP","MPP1","MPP2","MPP3","ST_HSC")

for (subtype in subtypes) {
  
  input_dir <- normalizePath(
  file.path("scMINER/SJARACNe", subtype, "TF"),
  winslash = "/"
)
  output_rds <- file.path("scMINER/SJARACNe", subtype, "TF", "network_stats.rds")
  
  # Run drawNetworkQC
  cat("Processing:", subtype, "\n")
  network <- scMINER::drawNetworkQC(sjaracne_dir = input_dir, generate_html = TRUE)
  
  # Save the network stats
  saveRDS(network, file = output_rds)
}

# 3) scMINER activity calculation with TF+SIG for all subtypes
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Biobase)  
})

subtypes <- c("CMP","GMP","LMPP","LT_HSC","MEP","MPP1","MPP2","MPP3","ST_HSC")

base_dir <- "scMINER/SJARACNe"

## Metadata extractor with SparseExpressionSet support
get_meta <- function(x) {
  cls <- class(x)
  if ("SparseExpressionSet" %in% cls || "ExpressionSet" %in% cls) {
    return(Biobase::pData(x))
  }
  stop("Unsupported object class: ", paste(cls, collapse = ", "))
}

## Gene and cell names (avoid touching assay matrix)
get_gene_names <- function(x) {
  if ("SparseExpressionSet" %in% class(x) || "ExpressionSet" %in% class(x)) {
    return(Biobase::featureNames(x))
  }
  stop("Unsupported object class for gene names.")
}
get_cell_names <- function(x) {
  if ("SparseExpressionSet" %in% class(x) || "ExpressionSet" %in% class(x)) {
    return(Biobase::sampleNames(x))
  }
  stop("Unsupported object class for cell names.")
}

## Safe subsetting that preserves sparsity for SparseExpressionSet
subset_eset_cells <- function(obj, cell_idx) {
  if (is.logical(cell_idx)) {
    cell_idx <- which(cell_idx)
  }
  if ("SparseExpressionSet" %in% class(obj) || "ExpressionSet" %in% class(obj)) {
    return(obj[, cell_idx])
  }
  stop("Unsupported object class for cell subsetting.")
}
subset_eset_genes <- function(obj, genes_keep) {
  if ("SparseExpressionSet" %in% class(obj) || "ExpressionSet" %in% class(obj)) {
    current_genes <- get_gene_names(obj)
    keep <- intersect(current_genes, genes_keep)
    if (length(keep) == 0L) {
      message("Warning: no overlap between network genes and dataset genes; keeping all genes.")
      return(obj)
    }
    return(obj[keep, ])
  }
  stop("Unsupported object class for gene subsetting.")
}

## Find a consensus network file in a directory, robust to small naming diffs
find_network_file <- function(dir_path) {
  if (!dir.exists(dir_path)) return(NA_character_)
  candidates <- list.files(dir_path, pattern = "^consensus_network_ncol.*\\.txt$",
                           full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
  if (length(candidates) == 0) {
    candidates <- list.files(dir_path, pattern = "ncol.*\\.txt$",
                             full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  if (length(candidates) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  # Prefer the bare consensus file over any NetworkQC HTML-adjacent copy
  exact <- candidates[basename(candidates) == "consensus_network_ncol_.txt"]
  if (length(exact) >= 1) return(exact[1])
  candidates[1]
}

## Read genes from a 2+ column edge list (TF \t Target); returns unique union
read_network_genes <- function(path) {
  df <- tryCatch(utils::read.table(path, sep = "\t", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, quote = "", comment.char = ""),
                 error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(df) || ncol(df) < 2) return(character())
  unique(c(df[[1]], df[[2]]))
}

phenoData(eset)$HSCscore <- gsub("-", "_", phenoData(eset)$HSCscore)

subtypes <- c("CMP","GMP","LMPP","LT_HSC","MEP","MPP1","MPP2","MPP3","ST_HSC")

## Determine annotation column automatically ---
meta <- get_meta(combined)
ann_candidates <- c("Subtype","subtype","celltype","CellType","Cluster","cluster","HSCscore")
ann_col <- ann_candidates[ann_candidates %in% colnames(meta)][1]
if (is.na(ann_col)) {
  stop("Could not find an annotation column among: ",
       paste(ann_candidates, collapse = ", "),
       ". Available columns: ", paste(colnames(meta), collapse = ", "))
}

activity_list <- list()

for (subtype in subtypes) {
  idx <- meta[[ann_col]] == subtype
  if (!any(idx, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    message(sprintf("No cells found for '%s' using column '%s' — skipping.", subtype, ann_col))
    activity_list[[subtype]] <- NULL
    next
  }
  
  tf_dir  <- file.path(base_dir, subtype, "TF")
  sig_dir <- file.path(base_dir, subtype, "SIG")
  
  tf_path  <- find_network_file(tf_dir)
  sig_path <- find_network_file(sig_dir)
  
  if (is.na(tf_path) || is.na(sig_path)) {
    message(sprintf("Missing TF or SIG network for '%s'. TF: %s | SIG: %s — skipping.",
                    subtype, ifelse(is.na(tf_path), "NOT FOUND", basename(tf_path)),
                    ifelse(is.na(sig_path), "NOT FOUND", basename(sig_path))))
    activity_list[[subtype]] <- NULL
    next
  }
  
  message(sprintf("Running %s | driver_type=TF_SIG | TF=%s | SIG=%s",
                  subtype, basename(tf_path), basename(sig_path)))
  
  # Reduce memory: subset cells, then genes to network union (preserves sparsity)
  sub_cells <- subset_eset_cells(combined, idx)
  net_genes <- unique(c(read_network_genes(tf_path), read_network_genes(sig_path)))
  sub_obj   <- if (length(net_genes) > 0) subset_eset_genes(sub_cells, net_genes) else sub_cells
  
  # Compute activity with TF+SIG (both required)
  act <- tryCatch({
    getActivity_individual(
      input_eset       = sub_obj,
      network_file.tf  = tf_path,
      network_file.sig = sig_path,
      driver_type      = "TF_SIG"
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(sprintf("getActivity_individual failed for '%s': %s", subtype, e$message))
    NULL
  })
  
  activity_list[[subtype]] <- act
}

## Optional: drop NULLs
activity_list <- activity_list[!vapply(activity_list, is.null, logical(1))]

## Save:
save(activity_list, file = "rda/activity_list_TF_SIG.rda")

## Heatmap individual
for (subtype in names(activity_list)) {
  activity_matrix <- Biobase::exprs(activity_list[[subtype]])
  
  top_tfs <- head(rownames(activity_matrix[order(rowMeans(activity_matrix), decreasing = TRUE), ]), 50)
  
  pheatmap(activity_matrix[top_tfs, ],
           scale = "row",
           show_rownames = TRUE,
           show_colnames = FALSE,
           clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
           clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
           main = paste("Top TF Activity -", subtype))
}

## Finding shared TFs
common_tfs <- Reduce(
  intersect,
  lapply(activity_list, function(x) rownames(Biobase::exprs(x)))
)

combined_activity <- do.call(
  cbind,
  lapply(activity_list, function(x) {
    mat <- Biobase::exprs(x)
    mat[common_tfs, , drop = FALSE]
  })
)

combined_activity <- do.call(
  cbind,
  lapply(names(activity_list), function(subtype) {
    mat <- Biobase::exprs(activity_list[[subtype]])
    mat <- mat[common_tfs, , drop = FALSE]
    
    colnames(mat) <- paste(subtype, colnames(mat), sep = "_")
    mat
  })
)

## Heatmap combined
group_labels <- rep(names(activity_list), times = sapply(activity_list, function(x) ncol(Biobase::exprs(x))))

# Optional: filter top TFs across all
top_tfs <- head(rownames(combined_activity[order(rowMeans(combined_activity), decreasing = TRUE), ]), 50)

pheatmap(combined_activity[top_tfs, ],
         scale = "row",
         annotation_col = data.frame(Subtype = factor(group_labels)),
         show_rownames = TRUE,
         show_colnames = FALSE,
         clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
         clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
         main = "Top TF Activity Across All Subtypes")


lapply(names(activity_list), function(subtype) {
  mat <- Biobase::exprs(activity_list[[subtype]])
  
  write.csv(
    mat,
    file = file.path("csv/", paste0("activity_", subtype, ".csv")),
    row.names = TRUE
  )
})
```
